selection_policy: Report all attempted candidates; choose a domain-relevant workload with stable held-out-query improvement for expanded evaluation; no universal real-data claim.

full.privacy_sweep_clean_references: Three clean methods have no epsilon input in algorithm decisions; reuse their full-size default measurements as horizontal references. Only noisy methods rerun at non-default epsilon; five curves still plotted.
full.extra_control: DANN+Bigram measured at default on 50 confirmatory queries.

split: Deterministic seed 20261015; exact sequence deduplication before 12 exploratory plus 50 distinct confirmatory queries; confirmatory queries excluded from pilot.
sequence_policy: No mutations, duplicated expansion or performance-based sequence selection; remove alignment gaps; retain actual ungapped sequences of length <=128; preserve source IDs.
partition: IID balanced shuffled round robin; NonIID group by provided family/class labels, not by measured nearest-neighbor results; simulated provider ownership explicitly disclosed.

second_stage_before_measurement.reason: Initial domain cap 2000 and curated RNA seeds show limited gains; test population density using full biological sequence matches without edits.
second_stage_before_measurement.query_policy: fixed hash cap then fixed shuffle, 12 pilot and disjoint50 confirmatory; no distance-based selection
second_stage_before_measurement.selection_metric: Among fixed pilot candidates, maximize the smaller of IID and NonIID DANN/FedSeq mean CPU ratios; expand only if both exceed 1.5. Confirmatory results may be weaker and will be reported unchanged.

canonicalization_amendment.reason: Source FASTA mixes T and U in 85 selected records. Normalize U to T before sequence deduplication so equivalent nucleotide representations do not create artificial distances.
canonicalization_amendment.candidate_selection_unchanged: Rfam full selected using original pilot; canonicalization is data-quality correction, not a new performance search.
